notes.title: Touhou Mystia's Izakaya Fan-Anime Opening!
notes.notes: [previewyoutube="CUGg9Yv6QAU;full"][/previewyoutube][p]The wait is over! The OP of Touhou Mystia's Izakaya: The Animation is finally here! [/p][p]The opening has actually been screened at various events starting from May, but those were incomplete versions, not the final version.[/p][p]This version you're seeing now is the completed version. This OP will give you a rough idea for the quality and style of the rest of the animation, so you can decide whether or not it's something you want to follow.[/p][p]But I'm sure everyone is looking forward to the animation, right? Right?[/p][p][/p][p]Below is a detailed look at the current progress of the animation, the status of production, and the answers to frequently asked questions/concerns.  Please bear with me as I go through them one by one:[/p][p][/p][p]A. Animation Progress[/p][p]While some parts of the animation are done, there's simply no way we're meeting the deadline we announced this summer, and we're very sorry for any disappointment! We simply have too much love for this anime, so we weren't able to control the impulse to fit in all the ideas we thought were cool, which added a boatload of work onto the work that already needed to be done. The trade-off is that everyone will be able to enjoy a richer and more complete anime filled with love. That's a promise![/p][p][/p][p]B. Status of Production[/p][p]Making an animation costs A LOT of money. According to the person in charge of overseeing production, making the opening you see before you has already burned just shy of 3.5k USD. If we want to make the rest of the animation, it could very well take a budget of up to 7k USD. Personally, I'd rather not have everyone working on passion alone, since some of our artists live in Japan and have a lot of expenses to take care of themselves, so it's only right that I take some of that burden off them. This will also ensure that the animation is high-quality. Therefore, we plan to release a small clip of the animation at the end of the month, allowing everyone to get a good grasp on the quality of the animation while also allowing us to begin selling CD keys and/or some merch. As crowdfunding has been banned, this is the only way we can reimburse the animation team right now. If you think the animation quality is satisfactory and you're willing to put your faith in us, this is how you can support us.[/p][p][/p][p]C. Frequently Asked Questions/Frequent Concerns[/p][p][/p][p]1. Buying the Animation[/p][p]According to our previous research, selling the animation on Steam as a DLC is preferable for a majority of players, so that's the method we're going with. The animation will sold as DLC on Steam that players can buy and watch directly. We'll also set up a new Steam page for the animation for those who don't own the base game but wish to purchase the animation. Naturally, there'll be special discounts for players who purchase it as DLC.[/p][p][/p][p]2. Animation Storyline[/p][p]Contrary to what many have speculated, the anime is NOT focused on retelling the game's story. Rather, it will focus on the parts of the story that weren't clearly shown or explained within the game. The bond between Mystia and her partners, parts that you didn't get to see due to development or being stuck in Mystia's point of view, and even some memes that have spawned within the community. All these will be animated in ordinary, slice-of-life style episodes. It's best to see it as more as a supplement to the main game![/p][p][/p][p]3. Animation Length/Update Schedule[/p][p]In line with most Japanese anime series, each episode will be around 20 minutes long, excluding the OP and ED. Ideally, we would like to release an episode every 6-12 months, until we've finished telling the story we wish to tell. Of course, there's the very real possibility that sales will stagnate and we'll have no choice but to stop production, but we'll put all our effort into making every episode the best it can be, so we hope that everyone will give us their support in this endeavor. I've already written the script for a very touching episode later in the series and it'd really be a shame if we had to stop production before it comes out![/p][p][/p][p]4. Anti-Piracy Measures[/p][p]Honestly, there's no way to stop piracy. The day the animation comes out, someone will have uploaded to various websites in half an hour, give or take. All I can say is, if you like our work, please support the official release. If you don't have the money to or can't afford to support us monetarily, you can watch a pirated version, just remember the people behind it. We'll still be very grateful if you ever decide to buy the official version one day!  As for those who do decide to support us through official channels, we'll be leveraging the strength of "games" as a medium and adding interactive achievements into the animation! In other words, these achievements can only be completed by players who buy the anime legitimately, which will distinguish official supporters and pirates. This is the most we can do at this stage.[/p][p]That's all we have to say about the animation for now. If you have any other inquiries or concerns, or would just like to send us words of encouragement, feel free to leave them in the comment section below! I'll be reading all of them![/p]

notes.title: Touhou Mystia's Izakaya Animation Teaser
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=TsakQEXRZA0;full][/previewyoutube]
youtube:[url=https://youtu.be/TsakQEXRZA0]https://youtu.be/TsakQEXRZA0[/url]

Touhou Mystia's Izakaya: The Animation is an animated adaptation of the izakaya simulation Touhou fangame by the circle Dichromatic Purpilion, Touhou Mystia's Izakaya.

This production of this animation was wholly realized by a team of fans, including the script, storyboard, illustration, music, sound effects and voice acting. Everything was done by fans; there are no commercial interests or commercial voice actors involved. It is purely a work by fans.

The animation will release with subtitles in 4 languages: Simplified/Traditional Chinese, Japanese, English and Korean. The same as the game.

While I am the developer of Touhou Mystia's Izakaya, I myself am a fan of this game as well. This animation will be made from the shoes of a fan, for the fans.

We plan to release the animation in episodes of around 10 minutes each, with the story being focused on parts of the game that are either lacking in description or parts I personally want to add to, serving as a companion piece to the game. Watching the animation in tandem with the game will give the best experience.

As the costs of making an animation are quite high, we currently don't know how many episodes we'll end up making. It's possible that we'll decide on the number of episodes based on the amount of sales.

We're still thinking on the distribution channel to use for the animation. We have at least 3 methods in mind:
- 1. Treat the animation as a special DLC and embed it into the game. Players who purchase the animation will be able to watch it ingame.
- 2. We might work with BiliBili and release it as a paid video (BiliBili has more experience in fighting piracy, and they can resolve such issues in our stead).
- 3. Distribute it physically as a collector's item.

Naturally, as time passes, other, better distribution channels may appear. Please look forward to it.

This teaser is to give an idea of the series's visuals in advance, such as the artstyle, expressiveness, voice acting, etc. I hope everyone can control or even lower their expectations, as that would give the best experience possible.

If everything goes to plan, we will release the first episode in summer of 2025, yet the future is full of uncertainty, so we can only hope everything goes well.

Thank you for your support.

notes.title: DLC5 Survival Mode Update,Other languages to be added in the future
notes.notes:
It's been a while, everyone. We've spent about a year from DLC5's release to today for the Survival Mode we promised.

We had to prioritize some agreements for the Switch version, so we pretty much had our hands tied with that until July. Then, this new gamemode just kept getting bigger and bigger, and in the end... 
we made something that more or less had the same amount of content as a DLC.

Naturally, as this is content we've promised from the very beginning, this update will also be part of DLC5 and will come at no additional charges, and we hope everyone can have fun with this new gamemode. Please report any bugs to our discord or email us at langqiaoemeng@qq.com and we'll fix it to the best of our ability.
As it was only released recently, there will certainly be some quirks that will require a week of player feedback to iron out.
We plan to add the gamemode to the Switch port around a month after it's stable.

Changelogs below.

[h2]New Content[/h2]
[list]
[*]Owners of DLC5 can now play the new update, Mystia's Izakaya Survival Mode challenge, by interacting with the rocket control panel in the Lunar Capital!
[*]The recipe for Mooncake has been added to Kourindou's misc catergory. (x5 frog coins)
[/list]

[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*]Regarding Pure Hell being unable to be stopped under the effect of certain spell cards: now whenever your trays cannot pick up any new dishes, swapping with it will now stop the effect and the kitchen will return to normal.
[*]Improved Sanae, Parsee, Okuu and Ellen's spell card VFX.
[*]Improved the display of results screen at the end of each night.
[*]Slightly increased the stock of the Kappa Merchant on Youkai Mountain.
[*]Scores from DLC2.5 can now be uploaded to the Steam Cloud.
[*]Now, in challenges where you need to reset your menu, the Stardust Boom, provided it has not been moved, can retain its original cook time.
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where pressing ctrl when adding ingredients that can't make any current dishes but CAN make dishes the player does not have the recipe to would crash the game.
[*]Fixed an issue where turning off DLC5 during the Lunar Capital story-lock and defeating Yuuma would crash the game.
[*]Fixed an issue where quitting to the main menu and returning after losing to Yuyuko would result in the player being unable to move.
[*]Fixed an issue with some saves where having "events that trigger upon leaving the hut after entering day time" and "events that trigger upon entering the hut" at the same time would crash the game.
[*]Fixed an issue in the dialogue screen where pressing confirm and scrolling up at the same time on the last sentence would crash the game.
[*]Fixed an issue where, if "Greasy" is trending, Suika ordering when possessed by Mizuchi would crash the game.
[*]Fixed an issue where giving a rare guest a drink which satisfies multiple liked tags would only unlock the corresponding liked drink tags.
[*]Fixed a discrepancy between the text and actual value in Doremy's hot springs buff.
[*]Fixed an issue where the "Divine Punishment" would appear during the third phase of Koishi's boss battle.
[*]Fixed an issue where autoscroll would break when framerate is uncapped.

Thank you to all the players for your support; you have helped this game grow. In a week, we will officially launch this game at 5.2. At that time, the physical cartridge will begin shipping, and the digital version will be unlocked.

notes.title: DLC5 is here! The final journey to Makai and the Lunar Capital begins!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275129/4ccb4b7ae46e11210e69104685175cc70dae5839.png[/img]

Dear players of Mystia's Izakaya, long time no see, or nice to meet you, perhaps.

With the advent of the Lunar New Year, DLC5 is officially going on sale. We've been working on this for a while now, so players who have been holding their breath can finally embark on another adventure. And this is your first time here, you now have another section of the map to explore.

As many of you know, this will be the game's final DLC. Once this DLC is published, all story content planned for Mystia's Izakaya will officially draw to a close. 
It may be a bit sad, but with goodbyes come new beginnings. In the coming days, we'll be reworking our plans in order to finish projects such as 
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1970020]Touhou Fairy Knockout[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1970030]Touhou Blooming Soul[/url] more efficiently.

Of course, our Aki Sisters farming game, which is also set in the same universe, will also hit the shelves next year. It's the same old business management simulator, this time set in a farm. Then, you'll be seeing the izakaya you've become so familiar with from another's perspective. The same faces will be there, and those past events will still be there; the point of view may be different, but the dream can still continue...

Now back to DLC5 itself.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275129/02c49775b67589e93b00af80df9884fa511259df.png[/img]

First of all, some bugs are inevitable when the game updates. Our playtesting team only consists of 20 people, and the number of people playing the game when it updates can easily go up into the thousands. The strength, size and reach would certainly dwarf ours in comparison, so you could expect some bugs which we have missed, even fatal ones. But, there's no cause for worry. We'll be closely monitoring everyone's feedback after release and fixing these bugs as soon as possible. Generally, it takes one or two weeks for a major update to become stable, so if you encounter any fatal bugs, don't rush into the game and be patient for a bit. We promise these bugs will be fixed in the shortest time possible.

If you encounter any bugs, feel free to leave a comment under this announcement or shoot me an email at [url=langqiaoemeng@qq.com]langqiaoemeng@qq.com[/url]. It'll bring it to our attention.

Actually, the characters that show up in the new Makai and Lunar Capital maps are all rather special. They're mostly characters from the PC-98 era or characters that seldom make an appearance in the Windows era. These characters share one special trait—they barely have anything describing them by the original creator. So, in order to make the story feel complete and have substance to it, we've come up with a hefty amount of our own canon, penning them stories which fit the style of Mystia's Izakaya. Some people may consider this OOC, so if that doesn't sit right with you, please don't buy or play this DLC.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275129/3e6828b19340160653388b1a6babd9d9e640305c.png[/img]

Lastly, the story of this DLC goes back to the heart of the game—the tale of the izakaya that values friendship and human connections—once again shedding light on the izakaya owner that is Mystia Lorelei. See what running the izakaya means to her and how she does so with all her heart and soul.

It's a Touhou fangame that would make all of us proud.

Also, we're planning a roguelike gamemode as a sendoff to the game. It's still in the testing phase at the moment, and due to its size, releasing it along with DLC5
would probably create the MOAB (Mother of All Bugs). That's why we decided to wait around a week to when DLC5 is in a more stable state. Please look forward to it.

Please take your time enjoying this DLC. Below are some ads about the game. Take a look if you have the time.

1. Preorders for physical copies + Limited Special Edition of Mystia’s Izakaya are coming to an end
Store url: [url=https://phoenixx.ne.jp/231216_yosuzume/]https://phoenixx.ne.jp/231216_yosuzume/[/url]
Please order on whichever platform you're most comfortable with!
All preorders will end on February 22, so place your orders while you still can! As we'll likely be making these based on the number of orders, there probably won't be a lot of surplus remaining.
Nintendo charges a fee for the game cards, and if you factor in the various cuts they take, we don't actually make much of a profit from game cards. We only went through with it to satisfy those among you that would like to own a physical copy of the game.
If you want a physical copy of this game, please don't miss out on this opportunity. Getting your hands on one in the future will be extremely difficult.

Aside from the game's opening and ending themes, we're also currently working on themes for the story of DLC1 - DLC5.

[h2]Updates: [/h2]

[b]The most important one: DLC4 now supports English![/b]

[b]Features and Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*]Added chat history: press the up key during a conversation to view the chatlog.
[*]Added the advanced filter: on any screen which lists items, click on the button or press the corresponding hotkey to open the advanced filter screen
[*]Added the game's English and Japanese logo.
[*]Added Japanese translations for part 2 and 3 of Marisa's bond description.
[*]Added VFX for Youmu and Yuyuko's reward spell cards
[*]Added an easter when you feed Yuuma a certain dish. This dish guarantees a "satisfied" (orange) rating from Yuuma, which can be used to ensure Yuuma doesn't invoke her reward spell card as an ordinary customer.
[*]Redid the VFX for Yuyuko and Meiling's reward spell cards
[*]Added a tutorial explaining Yuuma's bossfight which automatically displays when you fight her for the first time. You can also revisit the tutorial by talking to Kyouko.
[*]Kyouko now has tutorials related to favoriting, presets, the basement, Kourindou, Hakugyokurou and accessing DLC areas.
[*]All floating info panels during business have now been moved to the right.
[*]Players are no longer forced to sit through "recalled tutorials" again in order to get rid of the "haven't seen" tag.
[*]Merchants in the Forest of Magic and Palace of the Earth Spirits now have a low chance of selling grapes.
[*]Rinnosuke now has a small chance of appearing in the Forest of Magic.
[*]Bamboo Meat Pot's recipe now uses beef instead of pork.
[*]A secondary reminder will appear when a dish on Today's Menu doesn't have its corresponding station or is very low in quantity.
[*]Stations will now have their own unique background. During business, when a station's effects are successfully activated, the resulting dish will also have the corresponding background.
[*]Added an indicator to dishes that have additional ingredients. This indicator is visible on the tray.
[*]When buying recipes, players can now see the tags of the corresponding dish.
[*]On the third stage of the Bizarre Cooking Competition, Koishi's dislike tags won't have DLC4's poison-related tags.
[*]During a conversation, pressing C twice in a row will let you copy the current dialogue package
[*]Optimized save file loading. Now save files loading logic will only run when entering the game for the first time, when business ends and the save screen is entered, and when save files are refreshed manually.
[*]Improved readability of text bubbles.
[*]Improved readability of text on the CG screen.
[*]Improved readability of text on the serve/toss-serve screen.
[*]Improve the readability of the "next level" text on Mystia's notebook
[*]Improved the readability of text on the info screen.
[*]Improved the readability of prices on the shop screen.
[*]Improved the readability of text on the rhythm minigame tutorial.
[*]Improved the readability of descriptions on the wardrobe and items screen
[*]Optimized VFX of Alice's and Sanae's reward spell card
[*]Optimized particle count on some spell cards.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Tweaked the indicator of Kyouko's tutorial.
[*]Fixed the pupils of Kogasa's illustration being the wrong color
[*]Tweaked the description for how wine is brewed in the Scarlet Devil Mansion portion.
[*]Fixed a bug where the "Sour" tag wouldn't show unless DLC2 and DLC3 was owned.
[*]Fixed a bug where the game would take up more and more RAM while it was running.
[*]Fixed a bug where during toss-serving, while the dish is in the air and a partner serves a drink, completing said order, the index wouldn't automatically move on to the next order.
[*]Fixed a bug where while using the button to end business early and Remilia's spell card's second phase's maid summoning effect is triggered, the maids are still summoned and business is unable to end.
[*]Fixed a bug where Kagerou's and Shinmyoumaru's illustrations and rare customer data would be swapped in the Fanfare and Shining Needle Castle.
[*]Fixed a bug with the audience's orientation in the music competition.
[*]Fixed a bug with the character spacing being too small in the izakaya menu screen.
[*]Fixed a bug with temporary loading screens sometimes not appearing.
[*]Fixed a bug with using the trigger buttons to cycle between screens.
[*]Fixed a bug where there wasn't a hint for the function of alternating between the ingredients panel and the output panel with ctrl.
[*]Fixed a bug where partners would hang if the instant completion of Aya's Famous Shop stacks with Hina's/Youmu's/Okuu's instant completion effect.
[*]Fixed a bug where the handles on some progress bars were too small.
[*]Fixed a bug where the Japanese description of the QTE buff would overflow out of the textbox.
[*]Fixed a bug with the VFX of Kisume taking off and landing, similar to the VFX for Komachi's space manipulation.
[*]Fixed a bug where Aya's punishment spell card's "no long distance serving" effect would make it so you couldn't cycle between orders with the Q and E keys. Now, during the effect, the toss trajectory will not show.
[*]Fixed a bug with the VFX of Murasa's spell card.
[*]Fixed a bug where toss-serving's hint wouldn't display.
[*]Fixed a bug where forcefully closing the shop by holding X after all fairy maids summoned by Remilia's "Red, the Night Castle's" second phrase effect would cause an error.
[*]Fixed a bug where opening a UI screen while some spell cards were being declared would cause the sound effect to continue playing when the UI screen is kept open once the declaration ends.

notes.title: Discounts and Nintendo Switch Fanart Event!
notes.notes:
It's China's national day holidays, so our circle is having a discount on all your games! If you've been keeping an eye on them, now's a good chance to pick up our games!

But, what I really wanted to announce was that, to celebrate the launch of Mystia's Izakaya for the Nintendo Switch, we're accepting fanart submissions from fans like you for the third time! The event runs from October 1 to Ocotber 14! All fanart will be featured in the game's Switch album!

Be as creative as you want. Something related to the Nintendo Switch is best, but you can draw whatever your heart desires! When you're done, simply ping or DM me, or shoot me an email ([url]2573802958@qq.com[/url])! Anything is fine!

Not all submissions will make it though. Submissions that won't make it include but are not limited to R-14, obviously traced artwork, characters from other intellectual properties, unsuitable memes, art that includes assets from other games, as well as artwork that goes against public decency. It'll be shown on the "Nintendo" Switch after all, so I ask for your understanding. If your art doesn't make it, I'll personally inform you. 

I look forward to what everyone will come up with this time! Below is a rough outline of how we'll present the art in-game. Feel free to use it as a reference!

notes.title: DLC4已正式发布 大量优化更新见这里
notes.notes:
English version after, please hold on....

---------

大家久等了！自从2022年的11月18日开始，到现在已经过去了9个月了，一年的3/4就这样匆匆过去，我们也终于带来了大家期待已久的DLC4！

这次将是太阳花田和辉针城的故事，以及……一点点让东方老玩家揪心的幻想乡旧事。

对，那位少女会登场，带来一个开心的、暖心的、舒心的故事。

请尽情享受这次的DLC4。

---------

还有一件事，我们计划在2024年、夜雀食堂完成了全部DLC之后，发布本游戏的NS版本。

为了适配NS的性能，我们对游戏进行了釜底抽薪、大刀阔斧的优化。

这也是为什么这个DLC用了这么长时间的原因。

我们总结了一下这九个月以来我们的更新内容，大家可以参考这篇仔细看看：

刚刚更新的DLC肯定是有不少BUG的，欢迎大家在这里用评论回复告诉我，我们会整理并且尽量、尽快去修复，谢谢！

---------

[h2]新功能[/h2]
[list][*]我们设计了一个新版本的投掷上菜界面，希望他能够降低新玩家投掷上菜的操作难度，对于所有老玩家，这个功能默认关闭，并且可以在“设置”中开启
[*]我们更新了物品查看器，现在他不再会挡住对话框以及白天和工作场景左下角的提示
[*]在演唱会结束后，玩家会获得一个新的剧情，可以通过和慧音老师对话来解锁本该在幽幽子战失败才能获得的成就
[*]我们重新绘制了清晰度更高的演唱会、温泉CG，原本的CG可以在照片册中查看
[*]我们优化了游戏的一些调度和资源使用策略，现在游戏开启界面的速度应当更加流畅了
[/list]

[h2]优化[/h2]
[list][*]现在，所有点单都会显示点单客人的名字
[*]现在，演唱会在莉格露到来的情况下场地中会出现萤火虫
[*]现在，文文更有良心了，玩家首次遇到的流行事件必定为 流行·喜爱。且只会在以下tag中生成流行tag：甜、清淡、高级、下酒、饱腹、水产、家常、素，之后的流行机制不变
[*]现在，玩家不再会因为未知的原因不能开演唱会和睡觉了
[*]现在，老板娘笔记的图鉴中可以查看物品的价格了
[*]现在，工作场景中的Buff介绍控件会根据自己的大小智能的选择对齐策略
[*]现在，人里的前期支线任务“人类的宴客之道”现在会给予3瓶冬酿作为奖励
[*]现在，妹红喜欢上了烧烤Tag
[*]现在，跑腿小妹成就的需求次数降低到了原来的1/3
[*]现在，辉夜与妹红给出食谱的当晚就会前往竹林用餐而不是第二天
[*]现在，辉夜与妹红吵架的时候不会再去打电动了
[*]现在，和角色对话时选项会延迟0.5秒出现（避免误触）
[*]现在，酒水的酒精度数会强制作为第一个tag来展示
[*]现在，照片册中的演唱会CG有单人差分，希望能看到结局应援CG单人版的小伙伴开心了
[*]现在，玩家在白天的快速旅行界面选择传送地点时，会同时显示消耗的时间或金额
[*]现在，清兰和铃瑚也有立绘了
[*]现在，预设界面会显示当前剩余的可制作数量或酒水数量，且可以通过“设为首选”来让进入食堂配置界面时自动加载此乐社。
[*]现在，阿求粉丝与咲夜循环任务会提供更多的奖励
[*]现在，冴月麟奖励符卡带来的额外点单会在客人桌子上显示剩余的点单数量
[/list]

[h2]BUG修复[/h2]
[list]
[*]修复了给灵梦赛钱以后睡大觉，然后再去赛钱，在未退出游戏的情况下实惠料理加速BUFF可以多次叠加的问题
[*]修复了结算面板“演奏次数”一栏始终是0的问题
[*]修复了在地下室玩飞碟老虎机时中奖特效上有一个阴影的问题
[*]修复了地精客人被小桶驱赶时会卡住的问题
[*]修复了按住音量滚动条在进行连发调整时关闭界面后，滚动依然会继续的问题
[*]修复了日语还款CG金额单位错误的问题
[*]修复了电话机能通过批量邀请打给不在家的稀客的问题
[*]修复了菜谱筛选在切换语言后部分TAG依旧使用上一次语言的问题
[*]修复了客人在不决定续单的情况下会跳过预算检查判定的问题（导致即便客人没钱也不会触发后续影响）
[*]修复了尤魔战中右下角需求Tag在文本过长时可能会出现出框现象的问题
[*]修复了在客人走向队列中时遇到队列更新（客人离开队列或客人入座），会导致客人在等待时（队列更新时客人是按从前往后的次序移动到新的位置上的），继续向他们最后一次被设定的方向持续移动的问题（在视觉上来说会看到很多客人有严重穿模的问题）
[*]修复了当玩家金钱为负数时，所有的对话选项会直接不显示的问题
[*]修复了DLC3博丽大祭剧情中响子在对话结束后没有被隐藏的问题
[*]修复了妖梦试炼“收集符卡”文本可能被√×挡住的问题
[*]修复了人里通往魔法森林路障的显示错误
[*]修复了小伞的雨夜怪谈特效不是在场地中央的问题
[*]修复了主场景/结算场景中播放音乐可能无法对齐的问题

notes.title: ALL-TIME SPRING SALE LOW! SWITCH PORT IN THE WORKS!
notes.notes:
To all who've bought or haven't bought Mystia's Izakaya, we wish you an early happy [u]Mystia Day[/u] (World Sparrow Day)!

On the advent of spring in 2023, we bring two pieces of good news to all players—

Firstly, from March 17 to March 31, we'll be having a spring sale along with Steam! Within this period all games will be at an all-time low, for those looking forward to this game, this is prime time to grab yourself a copy. For those who've already bought the game but are wondering whether to get the DLCs and OSTs, this is also a once in a blue moon opportunity!

Now onto even bigger news. We've officially put into motion our plan to release Mystia's Izakaya on the Nintendo Switch. We've already obtained the a developer console and have begun porting and optimizating the game. Once we've finished DLC5, we'll officially start preparing for the release of the switch version! To that end, we've also drawn brand new art for the cover! For everyone who wants to play this game on switch, please be patient!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275129/2e6577ee76d16ecccf559056db2d45eed3a730b0.png[/img]

At the same time, from Mystia Day (March 17) to March 31, players who log in to the game will be given a free new skin—the cake dress. We hope this sugary, cake-themed dress is to everyone's liking! Of course, if you're really busy and can't spare the time and you miss the event, you'll still be able to buy it at Kourindou with frog coins.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275129/97137e3f1fb428c346749356cbe904b75030b1f8.png[/img]

Have fun!

notes.title: DLC2.5's new track editor! and some bug fixed
notes.notes:
It's been a long wait for proprietresses old and new! We've got some very important updates this time! Please check it out!

[h2]New Features[/h2]
A new free track editor for DLC2.5!
Since the release of DLC2.5: Music Lovers' Challenge, the DLC has been well-received by many players!
We've been working on an editor that allows players to use the music gameplay of DLC2.5 to create their own custom maps, and now that it's in a more stable state after two rounds of testing, we're henceforth releasing it!

The following are videos by some players showcasing their self-made maps during internal testing:
[url=https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1x3411D7yh]https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1x3411D7yh[/url]
[url=https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1SL41117Xf]https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1SL41117Xf[/url]

I hope this feature can give everyone a better gaming experience.

PS: Please be aware, the track editor is currently not supported on Mac.

[h2]Adjustments and Optimizations[/h2]
[list]
[*]Tweaked Rinnosuke's description of the "Savory" tag in the Chinese version.
[*]Yuyuko's budget has been increased from 1300~1800 to 1500~2000.
[*]Tweaked Yamame's Spell Card description in the Chinese version.
[*]Lowered the number of Spell Cards required for Yuyuko's second phase from 10 to 5. (Difficulty significantly decreased)
[*]Adjusted the default portraits of characters during work.
[*]Now during work, the UI for receiving tips occurs at a fixed interval. (So it's unlikely for the money to remain uncollected after business is concluded)
[*]Cheering sprites for DLC3 characters will now appear in Gensou Beat.
[*]The final task of the main game, starting the concert, now cannot be done during a night when another event(usually DLC) exists as well.
[*]Now when DLC files are missing, the system give a prompt for the missing DLC.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed various spelling and grammatical errors in the English translation of the game.
[*]Fixed a bug where some saves could not complete DLC3 due to the main concert not refreshing Mamizou's position.
[*]Fixed a bug where the effect of Kogasa's Reward Spell Card's additional order rate clashed with the effect of the Suspicious kitchenware.
[*]Fixed a bug where when queueing guests are seated during some active buffs, they will continue to be affected by it even after the buff ends.
[*]Fixed a bug causing left and right drift on controller.
[*]Fixed a bug where the [Items] tab of the inventory would display over hints.
[*]Fixed a bug where Kasen would not show up in Former Hell for some saves with the DLC2 pass.
[*]Fixed a bug where the system would not prompt you to go to the basement after receiving a new gift.
[*]Fixed a bug where the Third Eye/Eyes of Deduction would not update after guests are affected by Yuuma's Reward Spell Card.
[*]Fixed a bug where Nitori's bag would be shifted to her front when her sprite is viewed from behind.
[*]Fixed a bug where the stun duration of Tojiko's lighting strike in the DLC3 cooking contest was too short.
[*]Fixed a bug with the texture and effects layering of Futo's burning plates.
[*]Fixed a bug where some of the text in the inventory may be badly formatted in the English version.
[*]Fixed a bug where the seasoning label in the second phase of the DLC2 Bizarre Cooking Competition would not display in the Korean version.
[*]Fixed a bug where the names of Hakurei Shrine and Human Village were swapped in the Korean version.
[/list]

notes.title: DLC3 Release! Discounts! Autumn Sale! Mystia's Izakaya Major Content Update!
notes.notes:
It's been over a month since the last update, long time no see, everyone.

This time we're introducing the third story pack expansion - Myouren Temple & Divine Spirit Mausoleum
([url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2191950/DLC3/]Click here to purchase[/url])

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275129/d3ff3716514aa2f5c4d59d0430beb5caeab9d8cd.png[/img]
I believe some of you have already seen the news as we gradually release information on the game, and there's also been speculation on the game's content based on the public store page.

So what will everyone experience in this DLC? Please play the game to find out!

What's the general content of DLC3? Let's first take a look at this update video~!

[previewyoutube=WU9xF6qpppM;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]All characters from Myouren Temple and Divine Spirit Mausoleum will debut[/h2]
While not all of them are Bond characters, they'll all debut in various ways, and at least show their face.
Of course, since the nature of the game is relatively grassroots, the lower profile characters will have bigger roles than the higher profile ones.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275129/b1f1bdd8f85f6402cf38fa771f5044ea3daf55d4.png[/img]

[h2]Compared to the previous DLCs, we've increased the number of maps to 3[/h2]
In addition to Myouren Temple and the Divine Spirit Mausoleum, there's also an additional special dynamic map.
The duel will also take place on this special map...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275129/5a43e8fde91ca46e2fc6d14334607e046c2bde45.png[/img]

[h2]Expanded possibilities for the the ultimate showdown[/h2]
The base game, DLC1, and DLC2 are all about operating the izakaya for the boss battles. This time, there are more gameplay options.
DLC3 will be the first time where the final showdown has a branching route. Players can choose one of two ways to play.
So that there's no regrets, you can always return to continue the challenge.
In addition to managing the izakaya, the competition will also have musical duels.
Furthermore, the izakaya management part will also be very different from the previous...
In summary, it's an experiment to create a richer way to play.
In order to develop the game in the future, we want to bring fresh and more interesting gameplay to players.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275129/6bc7d55200613b071d207f62d56bdde5f403f43f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275129/1fb65448f1a4daab6b0ec7a8ccc8159f9550fe43.png[/img]

[h1]Next, the synchronized released of OST4[/h1]
See the purchase link on the right: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2194750/__OST4/]Click Here[/url]
As the music for DLC3 reached 15 songs, it's reached the minimum standard for us to release an OST.
Considering that there's still two more DLCs ahead, this music collection will be released directly and separately this time.
There's 15 excellent tracks that we hope you'll enjoy. If everything goes as planned, this will be the penultimate OST, with DLC4 and DLC5 combined for the final one.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275129/3651923e17f50162c37aceb5e5b44bea8fda4755.png[/img]

[h1]Thank you all for the enthusiastic participation in the 200,000 sales event![/h1]
In October, we reached 200,000 sales and held a campaign for artwork with our players. We've received many letters from all over the world.
At the time of the 100,000 sales Celebration Drawings, we mostly received drawings from mainland China. But this time around, with the game's introduction of some multilingual content, players from Japan, Korea, and even other countries have gradually gotten to know our game and sent in lots of celebration drawings.
We're all extremely grateful and touched. Everyone's drawings are so beautiful and entertaining, it's like Chinese New Year to receive so much support, and twice as much of it as the 100k campaign, which is even more surprising and delightful!
Thank you all for your wonderful love of our game. We've included the drawings in the game and have archived them for display in a new photo album, so please check out your works.
If there are any cases of omissions or mistakes, you can also email [url]langqiaoemeng@qq.com[/url] to explain and we'll make corrections or additions in a later update.
I've put some of the celebration drawings at the end of this announcement, so please enjoy! There are too many wonderful pictures, but we only have a limited number to display...
We've selected some of the interesting and outstanding representative works to display in this post.
Please feel free to enjoy the other two hundred works in the game!

[h1]Final Words[/h1]
Can't believe we've already reached DLC3. Since the start of the project from February 2019 and the game's Early Access announcement on June 16, 2021,the game has been in production for 4 years from development to continuous updates.
During this period, we've had plenty of love and support from the players. In fact, we had the idea of ending this project long ago to focus on new work. But for the fans of Touhou, in addition to graphics and gameplay, are most concerned whether the game can go further and realize their dream. Their dream of their favorite character, favorite story. What would they be like in this game?
Touhou Mystia's Izakaya has always had "human touch" as its main theme. To show everyone the warm, inclusive Gensokyo in our hearts, it's only natural to want to see how the characters they care about behave in this game, and what stories they will have.
"Let more characters on the stage" has been the core idea of DLC, supplementing and expanding the story of the characters. More and more players are happy with the expanded cast of characters and story, but the game is also becoming more bloated with more dishes and a higher percentage of those who make it once and never again. 
For the game's framework and production of ingredients, drinks, and recipes, etc., their presences are further diluted, but it can't be helped.
If the game had only 5 chapters, Mystia's Izakaya would be a decent simulation management cooking game. After more and more DLCs, it has evolved towards fanservice by selling interactions with new characters. We're well aware of this and accept the criticism of the players, and will be ending this game after DLC5.
In the meantime, we'll try to include as many characters as possible, and for those can't make it, please look forward to our next game! We've already got some interesting ideas!

Thank you for all the support so far, it's what has let us persist until now! The close positive communication cycle between players and production team has what made the game it is today.

notes.title: Discounts! New DLC! More languages! Updates aplenty!
notes.notes:
Good day everyone! Long time no see. In celebration of the Chinese National Day, this week we're introducing many new updates to Mystia's Izakaya.

[h2]Coming up first is——![/h2]

As of today, Mystia's Izakaya has already sold more than 200k copies!
To celebrate this occasion, we are now officially accepting fanart from all our players!
Submit your artwork to langqiaoemeng@qq.com before October 31st for a chance to have your artwork showcased in the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275129/b16a757797b858199f84e26eda5e408faa5d4e07.png[/img]
↑ We'll add your creation to the game's album like so. Pictured above is the 100k fanart event.

We first had this event back when the game sold 100k copies and it was a blast! We hope everyone has as much fun with this event as we did the first time around!
Anyone is free to submit their creation, no matter what country or region you live in! Most of the submissions from last time were from the Chinese community, but now that we support English, Korean and Japanese, we hope to receive blessings from players all around the world!
Let's all have fun together~!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275129/4cdd8d7d5f8a6a71d6e729c7e961d88c31863ea1.png[/img]
↑ Thanks to MichaelMac for contributing the above image!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275129/91b05ff9edb2b8df56e1aa9c87e649a95cff5961.png[/img]
↑ Thanks to 冰花月棱冰 for contributing the above image!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275129/14ee2dd5544ccabe8b7357b96664408f8dea6eec.png[/img]
↑ Thanks to amyonmyon for contributing the above image!

[h2]Now onto business! To start off, we bring you DLC2.5 "The Music Lover's Challenge"![/h2]

This is a DLC which expands on the rhythm game QTE. Purchasing this DLC allows you to strum the beats of all the ingame songs ala rhythm games. 

[previewyoutube=-h3ZH9dLW5o;full][/previewyoutube]
(If the video doesn't load, you can [url=https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1aG411G77r]watch the BiliBili version here[/url].)

This is an expansion DLC. In addition to granting the wishes of those who want to play a rhythm game inside Mystia's Izakaya, it's also a new gameplay mechanic for DLC3's "ultimate battle". We hope you look forward to what we have in store for future updates~

Only 1.99USD! Interested? Click [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2122050/]here[/url] to buy it right now!

To summarize, in this DLC, you will get:
- Up to 35 ingame songs available for rhythmic action
- An all new mini-story about the music lover
- The appearance of a mysterious new character
- A big pile of beautiful melodic badges
- A charming punk outfit
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275129/8fe2436fa7a50c90d65455e1d7599cc1bed0fd51.png[/img]

We hope you have fun with this DLC!

[h2]Discounts on our entire line of games![/h2]

Games which have a discount include:
- [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1584090/]Touhou Mystia's Izakaya[/url], including all OSTs and DLC. 
- [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1124830/]Touhou Blooming Chaos 1[/url],  including all OSTs and DLC. 
- [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1260810/]Touhou Blooming Chaos 2[/url],  including all OSTs and DLC. 
- [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/941300/]Touhou Nil Soul[/url],  including all OSTs and DLC. 

Basically, everything has a discount! Happy spending!

------------

[h2]Moving on, we have some important updates for our games[/h2]

Firstly is the much anticipated update to our game's translated versions
- DLC1 Japanese beta version added
- DLC2 Korean beta and English version added
There may be some bugs in the translations during the initial phases, but we'll continue to smooth them out. Polishing text takes a bit longer than usual, so we kindly ask for everyone's patience.

Secondly, we've added a lovely ingame achievement system which uses charming badges. It's pretty cool.
In the future we'll sync it up to the achivements on Steam and gradually add in achievements from DLC1 and DLC2.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275129/1fc07ea04d2020a680bbbcb808f944dbc2717486.png[/img]

We've also added artwork for skins from DLC1 and DLC2. Players that have already completed DLC1 and DLC2's bond tasks can check out these costumes straight away, no strings attached.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275129/7a390329070fa15eb2a729b62b2e082df14c4b36.png[/img]
TMI players one year ago: *Manages the izakaya properly, make friends with everyone, enjoys a relaxing story in Gensokyo
TMI players now: I just want to see how cute the devs can make Mystia!

Added a new feature that allows players to skip a day. Simply interact with the bed in your room to skip the day without opening the izakaya.
This is something everyone needs right?
It only works if you don't have anything happening that night though.

It was simply too cute, so we made two emojis for everyone to use as they like
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275129/ed2ff396154a3b46f47bb26f94f382be54313ca1.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275129/f5eca6ce309e502bcc863e1931acb4b86fb648ce.gif[/img]

As well as a non-captioned version where people can put whatever they please
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275129/d558fa04067d39c606cc51b32e3f7934e465ab2f.gif[/img]

------------


[h2]Next up are the normal updates[/h2]
[list]
[*]The save screen now supports saving up to 15 files
[*]The status screen of Notebook now has a new third page for displaying badges
[*]The Recipes and Tasks screen of Notebook no longer lags due to holding too many recipes or tasks
[*]The flag function of the Inventory screen now has a more noticeable marker
[*]The Izakaya selection panel now supports viewing warehouses and notes
[*]The Izakaya configuration panel now has an additional tool button to support viewing warehouses, notes, and custom presets
[*]The exit screen now has a more intuitive secondary menu for returning to the main menu/exiting the game
[*]Fixed the problem that players in certain regions could not save their game
[/list]

------------

[h2]Blooming Soul has also been updated![/h2]

This time we've added Reimu who represents "sorrow", this is a character who focuses on defending and counter-attacking.
Difficulty-wise, she's on par with Mokou with a level of 2, making her stronger than Kogasa who's only level 1.
[previewyoutube=7OrEwwziKDY;full][/previewyoutube]
(If the video doesn't load, you can [url=https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1WG4y1x7xM/]watch the BiliBili version here[/url].)

Also, we've added a tutorial in this update, making it easier for players to understand the basics of swapping emotions.
Next time we'll add another boss, then we'll get ready to make the actual stages!

notes.title: Normal Update and BUG fixed RELEASE 1.9.3k#2
notes.notes:
RELEASE 1.9.3k#2

We've fixed some bugs and made some optimizations, details below:
- Fixed a bug where players could use the telephone to invite NPCs again after initially failing to invite them.
- Fixed a bug where players could use the telephone to bulk buy from merchants even after they have already sold out.
- Fixed a bug where Yuuma's Violence Meter would not increase after failing to satisfy her.
- Fixed a bug where Yuuma would request the combination of Mountain Delicacy + Vegetarian tags.
- From now on, a friendly reminder will appear on the bottom-left corner during the last day an important task(ones that lead to a Bad Ending) can be completed.
- We've adjusted how quickly the music transitions during business, such that a newly opened shop won't immediately reach Vibe Level 3.
  - If the player has served more than 10 guests, and 1/3 of the business hours have passed, the Vibe Level will be increased to 2.
  - If the player has served more than 20 guests, and 2/3 of the business hours have passed, the Vibe Level will be increased to 3.
  - If the player's Combo is broken, the music's Vibe Level will immediately, decrease and only increase again after getting a Satisfied rating from 5 more guests in a row
  
We hope you have fun with our game!

notes.title: 514 Koishi's Day! DLC2 RELEASE!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275129/1782af3d63f301d7a1581e7064dc1b602662df61.png[/img]

IMPORTANT: Please back up your save file before installing DLC2.

As a team, we hope everyone who likes the original Touhou Subterranean Animism and the characters a happy May 14th – which is Koishi’s Birthday!

After the long wait, TouhouMystia Izakaya DLC2 is officially released! The Former Hell and the Palace of the Earth Spirits will be unlocked with this DLC. You can purchase it here：[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1927110/DLC]Touhou Mystia's Izakaya DLC2 Pack[/url]

Please note that the English version of the DLC2 is not available yet. We anticipate that this DLC can be fully translated in about 3-4 months. We will update accordingly if the progress is faster or slower than planned.

Along with DLC2, we are also proud to release another music DLC. ([url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1982490/__OST3/]点击这里查看[/url]) This one includes the OST from both DLC1 and DLC2. We want to have about 20 OSTs for every music DLC. If we release the music DLC just for DLC1, then we cannot meet this number. This is why we combined OSTs from both DLC and released them together. We apologize for the long wait. We hope you enjoy our music. 

Without further ado, let’s get into DLC2’s content.

New Location: Former Hell & Palace of the Earth Spirits. You can unlock it after you have finished the story in the Hakurei Shrine.

Our proprietress Mystia came to the abandoned Former Hell. What kind of new adventure will she encounter in this secluded yet self-sustaining society?

At the center of the Former Hell stands an ancient building, known as the Palace of the Earth Spirits. Who resides in such a place?

New journey, new story, and new friends.

Proprietress’s underground adventure, starts now——

As with the 1.0 patch, there might be some undiscovered bugs. Please let us know if you encounter any in the comment section. We will work overtime for the first 3 days after the initial release to squash any significant or game-breaking bugs. We apologize ahead of time for any inconvenience caused. . . 

Next is the quality of life improvement reports:

[h2]New content and quality of life change[/h2]
[list]
[*]A new entrance is added in the Hakurei Shrine that connects to Former Hell.
[*]The menu will remember your previous choice when you purchase something with the phone.
[*]Meng Chenguo can now be controlled through the Collab Terminal.
[*]You can now scroll freely in the album and the menu at night.
[*]When you talk to NPCs, they will now turn toward you.
[/list]

[h2]BUG Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed a problem where partners’ speed didn’t make any difference.
[*]Fixed a problem that incorrectly displayed Youmu’s grandfather as Youmu's grandmother.
[*]Fixed some text position problems.
[*]Changed Marisa’s conversation at the concert.
[*]Fixed a problem that when using the phone, the cursor will move to the top instead of the previous position.
[*]Previously, Tewi’s reward spell card did not affect gathering by NPCs. Now Tewi’s spell card will impact NPC gathering. Now you should all worship Tewi at night!
[*]Removed the first default cookware at challenge events.
[*]Fixed a problem that in some save files, Kyouko and Marisa would disappear after the concert.
[*]For the Chinese version, “井蒂莲” will now be changed to “并蒂莲”
[*]Now, before you obtain the operating permit for Former Hell and Palace of the Earth Spirits, merchants at the corresponding location will not answer your call.
[*]Removed Orin’s dislike tag – weird.
[*]Adjusted the entrance to the Former Hell in the Hakurei Shrine. 
[*]Fixed a problem where no rare guests could spawn at challenge 2.
[*]Fixed a problem where Okuu’s reward spell card would erase Youmu’s reward spell card.
[*]Fixed a problem that you can call Meng Chengguo even when you have not started the Collab event.
[*]Fixed a problem where holding the W key and then the cancel key in the map menu will cause it to lose focus.
[*]Fixed a problem where hitting the ESC key will cause the cancel key to lose its effect after leaving the load save menu.
[/list]

notes.title: Important quality of life improvement in 1.8.2o, DLC1 English Patch Ready
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Sorry for the long wait. Today we have updated the game. This update’s primary focus is quality of life improvements and bug fixes. Hopefully, we can use this opportunity to make the experience that much more enjoyable for current and future content.  

Without further ado, let’s get into it.

[h2]Important Update[/h2]
[olist]
[*] DLC1’s English Patch is ready! The main game - Touhou Mystia’s Izakaya now officially supports English.
English players can now experience this game without any obstacles! 
To celebrate this milestone, we will go on sale starting this week! If you miss this opportunity, then you have to wait a while!
Of course, we are still finding typos and grammatical errors here and there. However, rest assured that we will fix them in future updates.
Unfortunately, Japanese players still need to wait a little longer. Please be patient.
[*] New ingredients, recipes, beverages, and cookware prioritization function. Use ` key to open your backpack, and you can prioritize ingredients, recipes, beverages, and cookware. Prioritized items will show up at the top of the list when you are operating your izakaya. With this function, you can quickly access your favorite items without manually searching for it or scrolling down.You can prioritize at most 5 ingredients for each kind of ingredient. For other categories, you can prioritize at most 10 items.
[/olist]

[h2]New features[/h2]
[list]
[*] When purchasing ingredients, you can now hold E and purchase everything. 
[*] Because many players are confused about when DLC1’s storyline officially started, we added a Bunbunmaru Newspaper article to tell players exactly when DLC1 is accessible. 
[*] When you are operating level 1 or level 2 izakaya, random people will walk past your izakaya at night. Experience a night at Gensokyo with your small izakaya as an authentic street vendor! 
[*] After you have access to Yakumo Gap, you can now use the gap in your map (default key M), instead of having to walk to the gap every time. 
[*] If you have a quest about serving a certain dish to a rare guest at your izakaya, you will now have a notification on top as a reminder. 
[*] If there is a story event at night that forces you to operate at a certain location, you will now be notified when the day starts. 
[*] Added A LOT of 10w celebration pictures.
[/list]

[h2]Adjustments & Quality of life improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] You can now use L1 and L2 (shoulder buttons) to switch between orders at night. You can also use L2 and R2 (trigger buttons) to check your buff. 
[*] A special gap effect for Yukari when she appears at the end.
[*] Normal Guests “Taotie Beast” has been changed to Youkai Snake to avoid confusion. 
[*] Updated descriptions to reflect that Yuuma ignores Night Sparrow Cookware effect.
[*] Tachisora Shio will no longer activate multiple spell cards at once. Instead, additional spell cards will increase the duration of the first spell card. 
[*] Shanghai Doll will more likely sell cream. 
[*] DLC1 will also have Halloween and Christmas decor when you have the right costumes. 
[*] Now you can change store decor independently from the costumes. 
[*] Updated Nitori’s Heavy Industry Phone. Now, when a conversation is over, it will return to the previous menu instead of closing the menu. 
[*] Reduced Marisa’s spell card’s visual effect. 
[*] In Yuyuko’s revisiting battle, an orange rating will increase the progress by 20. 
[*] Changed 10,000 sales album location. 
[*] Recipe sorting feature. You will now have two levels of menu. With this, you can now easily access all your favorite recipes. 
[*] Now when you get beverages from the wine rack, if you hit the “up” key from your tray, you will move to the beverages on the lowest rack. 
[*] Once you interact with the Jizo Statue, you won’t be able to interact with it again that day. 
[*] Now, the money you spent on using gaps will also be displayed when calculating your daily revenue.
[*] Chen’s spell card will no longer give you Sea Urchin and Octopus.
[*] Now the record player will display its cover when you select it. 
[*] You can purchase Yumma’s battle theme after you defeat her at Kourindou.
[/list]

[h2]BUG fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed the problem that sometimes some players cannot enter the game. 
[*] Fixed the problem that sometimes there is a “chat” button  even when Mystia is not chatting with someone. 
[*] Fixed the problem that Forest of Magic level two izakaya’s default background is set to Spring Festival background.

[*] Fixed the problem that Tewi could not force a sale at level 2 and 3 izakaya in the Bamboo forest before the duel between Mokou and Kaguya. Also fixed a problem where Tachisora Shio, Satsuki Rin, and Three Hoppin' Fairies' would not show up in the Bamboo forest at higher level izakaya. 
[*] Fixed the problem that some players’ save file does not contain Sakuya’s ingredient quest.

OK. We currently anticipate another update in April. After that, we’ll release DLC2. 
Please look forward to it~

notes.title: 100,000 Copies sold!Big Valentine’s Day Version Update

Happy Valentine's Day (although it's already a day late)! First of all, a big thank you to everyone who supported us during the Lunar New Year!
Thanks to all of your support, "Touhou Mystia's Izakaya" has finally sold more than 100k copies! It only took us 8 months since leaving Early Access last June 16!
This is a very memorable event in the history of Touhou fangames. We are honored to develop such a game and show it to the world!
For this reason, we have started a submission contest! If you also enjoyed our game and want to join us in celebration, you can email us your fanart at langqiaoemeng@qq.com

[*]Fixed a bug where Mystia would no longer be able to send dishes when ingredients were

OK, that's all for the update. Thank you for the support!

notes.title: We are starting Mac OS Version Beta testing!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275129/c89b93f22dbda9779cacff742ee8c15014be1ca7.png[/img]

Long wait for the Mac OS users! We finally succeeded in releasing a version with Mac OS support after some time of work.
However, since we don't have many test participants around, there may be some unknown issues, so if you are running Mac OS and would like to participate in testing, it would be welcome for you to enter our beta testing branch.

Here is how to participate:

1. Open your Steam Library, right click on "Touhou Mystia's Izakaya" and select "Properties".

2. Select "Betas" in the opened window.

3. Enter the code "byqfamjm7gt8d7w" into the "Enter beta access code to unlock private betas:" text box, and then click "Check Code", will get a notification that the "mac_os_test" branch is available.

4. Next, select "mac_os_test" in the drop-down menu above, this will change your current branch into the Mac OS Beta, and you will find a "[mac_os_test]" appended to the game name in your Library list, the existence of the suffix means that you are currently in Mac OS Beta.

5. Exit and Restart Steam, after which the game will automatically begin to update, you can enter and try out the Mac OS Beta after the update.
Although Steam will immediately prompt you to update just after switching branches, there are cases of an incomplete update, so restarting Steam for the update is a safer practice.

We will test the game on this branch for a while and release the official version after critical issues have been addressed.
If you encounter bugs in this branch, please report to us through this email address [serv1ce-deyu@qq.com] , we will review and fix as soon as possible.

And we’d like to ask for your support in the “Sit back and relax” category during this steam award season. 

Although we fully acknowledge that the lack of an English version might bring you some difficulties, but we are working hard on the English release and sincerely wishes that you enjoy our game.

If you do have a great time with Mystia's Izakaya, please let us know by voting in this steam award under the “Sit back and relax”!

And last, since we cannot repay you enough other then our hard work and new content, if Mystia's Izakaya do get a nomination in the Steam Awards in the end, we will make a new skin for all of your support.

notes.title: 夜雀食堂制作组邀请您来进行v1.5.0+版本的Beta测试 ：)
notes.notes:
[h2]前言[/h2]

大家久等了，又到了夜雀食堂大版本更新的前夕，这次更新了非常、非常、非常多的内容，但是很难保证没有问题。为了在正式版之前尽量的让版本稳定，所以我们这次发布技术测试版，给愿意参加测试的玩家游玩，帮助我们一起改进游戏。

首先，这是技术测试版的更新，所谓的“[b]技术测试版”[/b]，就是把接下来要更新的内容，提前放给一定范围的用户进行测试，以便在正式发布之前能够找到和排除问题，让正式上线的版本更稳定。

所以这个版本仍然可能会存在很多问题，请有意愿参与测试、提前体验内容的玩家踊跃参加。而且参与技术测试的玩家，打出来的数据不一定能够保留。

说人话就是：
[b]参加技术测试版可以提前体验内容，但可能问题会比较多，而且存档可能无法保留[/b]。

所以希望等稳定版本、或是保留存档的玩家，我们不推荐加入技术测试。

----------

[h2]参加方法[/h2]

1、打开steam，对着“东方夜雀食堂”右键，选择“属性”

2、在打开的新窗口里选择“测试版”

3、在“请输入测试访问代码来解锁私密测试权限”的选框里，输入“88djHd99FerLPtd3D”，然后点“检查代码”，就会得到一个通知“betatest”分支已经可以使用

4、接下来在上方的下拉选单中，选择“betatest”，这样你的游戏就会进入到技术测试版的分支，在您的库清单中，东方夜雀食堂的名称后面会加入[betatest]，有这个后缀，代表您已经是技术测试版了，如果没有，则依然是现在线上的正式版

5、好，退出steam，重启steam，这个时候游戏会开始更新，更新完后，就可以进入技术测试版了。虽然刚刚切换分支之后，也可以更新，但是尽量不要相信这个，它容易更新不完整，所以退出steam并重启，可以比较保险的更新。

经过上一次betatest的测试，好像这个测试名额是有上限的，如果您按照操作执行却没有办法达成上面的效果，那就可能是达到了上限，我们得研究一下怎么解除这个上限…

------------

[h2]重要说明[/h2]

OK，如果您进入了技术测试版本，接下来是重要的测试说明：

1、首先，在技术测试的版本中，您的存档不会被当前、以及未来更新的正式版本继承。

2、如果您在技术测试版本里进行了存档操作，该存档会显示“技术测试”的角标。但它并不会覆盖您现有的存档，而是存储在其他位置，当您切换成线上正式版本时，原本在对应位置存档将依然可用。

3、虽然存在将存档从“技术测试”专用的存档文件夹拷贝到“正式版本”的存档文件夹这一操作，但是大概率这可能在正式版本中产生问题，并且也是不推荐的行为。

3、技术测试版本是为了提前寻找潜在的程序问题，如果您在这个版本中遇到了问题，请通过以下的在线文档根据表格内容进行反馈，我们会尽快进行复现和修复

https://docs.qq.com/sheet/DVFdoWGxkY3FkdWFw?friendUin=ZZO%252BZ0tOaSDZBN0chgYY6A%253D%253D&tab=BB08J2
(在b站只能直接发站内链接，所以需要大家用电脑端复制一下上方地址，贴到浏览器里打开)

4、技术测试版重新开启了右边的存档和log输出，如果遇到任何问题，可以马上输出存档和日志信息，发往邮箱 serv1ce-deyu@qq.com 并且备注一下情况，我们看到后就会处理。

------------

[h2]大家最关心的，本次的技术测试的内容、也是未来更新到正式版中即将实装的内容[/h2]

notes.notes:
[h2]前言[/h2]

大家久等了，又到了夜雀食堂大版本更新的前夕，这次更新了非常、非常、非常多的内容，但是很难保证没有问题。为了在正式版之前尽量的让版本稳定，所以我们这次发布技术测试版，给愿意参加测试的玩家游玩，帮助我们一起改进游戏。

首先，这是技术测试版的更新，所谓的“[b]技术测试版”[/b]，就是把接下来要更新的内容，提前放给一定范围的用户进行测试，以便在正式发布之前能够找到和排除问题，让正式上线的版本更稳定。

所以这个版本仍然可能会存在很多问题，请有意愿参与测试、提前体验内容的玩家踊跃参加。而且参与技术测试的玩家，打出来的数据不一定能够保留。

说人话就是：
[b]参加技术测试版可以提前体验内容，但可能问题会比较多，而且存档可能无法保留[/b]。

所以希望等稳定版本、或是保留存档的玩家，我们不推荐加入技术测试。

----------

[h2]参加方法[/h2]

1、打开steam，对着“东方夜雀食堂”右键，选择“属性”

2、在打开的新窗口里选择“测试版”

3、在“请输入测试访问代码来解锁私密测试权限”的选框里，输入“88djHd99FerLPtd3D”，然后点“检查代码”，就会得到一个通知“betatest”分支已经可以使用

4、接下来在上方的下拉选单中，选择“betatest”，这样你的游戏就会进入到技术测试版的分支，在您的库清单中，东方夜雀食堂的名称后面会加入[betatest]，有这个后缀，代表您已经是技术测试版了，如果没有，则依然是现在线上的正式版

5、好，退出steam，重启steam，这个时候游戏会开始更新，更新完后，就可以进入技术测试版了。虽然刚刚切换分支之后，也可以更新，但是尽量不要相信这个，它容易更新不完整，所以退出steam并重启，可以比较保险的更新。

经过上一次betatest的测试，好像这个测试名额是有上限的，如果您按照操作执行却没有办法达成上面的效果，那就可能是达到了上限，我们得研究一下怎么解除这个上限…

------------

[h2]重要说明[/h2]

OK，如果您进入了技术测试版本，接下来是重要的测试说明：

1、首先，在技术测试的版本中，您的存档不会被当前、以及未来更新的正式版本继承。

2、如果您在技术测试版本里进行了存档操作，该存档会显示“技术测试”的角标。但它并不会覆盖您现有的存档，而是存储在其他位置，当您切换成线上正式版本时，原本在对应位置存档将依然可用。

3、虽然存在将存档从“技术测试”专用的存档文件夹拷贝到“正式版本”的存档文件夹这一操作，但是大概率这可能在正式版本中产生问题，并且也是不推荐的行为。

3、技术测试版本是为了提前寻找潜在的程序问题，如果您在这个版本中遇到了问题，请通过以下的在线文档根据表格内容进行反馈，我们会尽快进行复现和修复

https://docs.qq.com/sheet/DVFdoWGxkY3FkdWFw?friendUin=ZZO%252BZ0tOaSDZBN0chgYY6A%253D%253D&tab=BB08J2
(在b站只能直接发站内链接，所以需要大家用电脑端复制一下上方地址，贴到浏览器里打开)

4、技术测试版重新开启了右边的存档和log输出，如果遇到任何问题，可以马上输出存档和日志信息，发往邮箱 serv1ce-deyu@qq.com 并且备注一下情况，我们看到后就会处理。

------------

[list]
[*]实装了华彩乱战2的联动
[*]实装了三妖精的蹦蹦跳跳讨伐大作战的联动
[*][b]优化游戏文件大小到约700M[/b]
[*][b]优化游戏运行时内存占用[/b]
[*]实装了各个地区的描述
[*]实装了店面的描述

[*][b]全新的等级系统，并且不再会根据剧情锁定等级，您之前积累的经验值，会自动换算成新等级系统的等级，并且修得对应的能力，试试看吧[/b]
[*][b]在笔记本中新增Tag筛选功能[/b]
[*]开店准备时，如果不满足最低开店的菜品酒水时，会进行更醒目的提示
[*][b]已上的菜品酒水，在订单里会有标识[/b]
[*]和白天时的稀有NPC对话后出现的对话选项现在支持循环滚动功能
[*][b]设置中新增关闭符卡宣言动画的选项[/b]
[/list]

[h3]调整[/h3]
[list]
[*]万圣节赠服装活动结束，作为奖励的万圣节晚装现在移动到香霖堂，并且通过在守矢神社抽奖获得的青蛙硬币兑换
[*]现在在妖梦挑战中，当玩家到达了挑战目标后会直接结束当前挑战，不需要经营到时间结束

[*][b]现在，主打菜单的菜或酒卖完后，普客则会点海鲜味噌汤和绿茶(不包括保温箱内的和做完的)[/b]
[*]现在触发奸商因幡帝的奖励成就会映射到普通帝身上，触发“Combo消失术”也会获得相应的惩罚符卡成就
[*]现在CG界面中对于惩罚游戏·辉夜/妹红的CG收集状态将从所有存档的完成进度中选择，就是说，如果你有两张CG都存在的存档，那么在相册里就会同时显示两张CG
[*]现在在完成最后的任务的同时，妖梦会离开博丽神社
[*]现在挑战模式中不再会给稀客增加好感度
[*]微调对话选项菜单来适配多行文本
[*]现在包含有五个食材的料理将自带大份Tag
[*]现在毛玉冰添加无酒精，甘，水果Tag
[*]现在与同时拥有依赖任务以及售卖物品的白天普通NPC对话会显示二选一的选择界面，而不总是打开商店
[*]现在在读取存档的时候会尽可能的更新存档内已经完成的成就
[*]现在解锁白天地图时会产生提示
[*]老板娘笔记-图鉴-客人页面现在不再需要额外的一次点击来查看完整的人物介绍
[*]调整了一些文案
[/list]

[h3]问题修复[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]修复了当处于投掷上菜时打开任意上菜模组都会导致原本在桌上的料理外观消失的问题[/b]

[*]修复了红魔馆支线“求助！特殊料理的参考，其之二”要求的料理和对话内容不符的问题

notes.title: Touhou Mystia’s Izakaya, imposing update!
notes.notes:
Players longing for update, sorry for keeping you waiting, we are here now! Oh, and the English, Japanese version is being prepared by the way!
Since everyone has a different situation, I suggest to backup your saves before entering them after updating. It’s only a small chance, but if the saves crashed it’ll be a big loss for you. 
Directions:
Enter the game' and double click “savedata”, then copy and paste everything within it somewhere else.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275129/09c740d02fb376c898d7f1e99b096a3cd8ad7ea7.png[/img]


Touhou Mystia’s Izakaya is meeting players with a full edition after two years and eight months. This project was settled in February 2019, even before our Blooming Chaos series, yet we finished it until today, so many complicated and entangling stories happened while we were making it…
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275129/35ab9482f2fb062d5f885c54fe3577cd529af055.png[/img]
▲It might be hard to believe the first edition on February looked like this

Of course, these things happen to every game producer, how much pain it gives during the process, how much pride and honor it returns when finished, and echoes on.

So, let’s talk about the Final Edition

[h2]Here’s some little forwords：[/h2]
[list]
[*]First of all, although this is the final edition, to be honest, we still left many places abrasive. We did our best to test it, eliminating as many malignant bugs as we could, but we only have twenty workers in the studio, much less than the players after publishing. There will be many new problems emerging as you play, please give us feedback, we’ll use full effort to solve them! [list]
[*] Any feedback please email here: serv1ce-deyu@qq.com[/list][*] We found many places can be improved after playing it ourselves, so we will still be working on it after the final edition is published to make this game better.
[*] Because we suddenly decided to add new songs to the game in August, the ambience music for Scarlet Demon Mansion and Bamboo Forest of The Lost are still devoid, we will add it in the game within October. Please forgive us, it’s an improvise after all, but will definitely make the game better, please give us some time!
[*] We originally wanted to return the drinks straight to the shelf instead of using the recycle bin, but time wasn’t our friend… so this edition doesn’t not include this function, we’ll add it later on, so far the returning of drinks still relies on the recycle bin.
[*] Besides bug fixing and detail improving, we will begin development on the English and Japanese Version soon. So Touhou fans around the world, cross culture, can enjoy the charisma of this game.
[/list]

[h2]Then is our update content: [/h2]
[olist]
[*] The characters, musics, incidents, stories of Scarlet Demon Mansion, Bamboo Forest of The Lost Hakugyokurou were all added
[*] Three intense and breathtaking Boss fights, watchout don’t be crushed by Yuyuko!
[*] Friend(waitress?)system is added, there are five friends who can help you business! 
[*] Basement is finally built, it contained a phonograph, an album and a closet for different outfits!
[*] Of course the achievements.
[*] Kourindou opened for business! You can buy special materials here, more powerful and seemingly dangerous kitchen wares and CDs of different areas here!
[*] Many minor detail changes, please find them out with your own eyes!
[/olist]

After all, hope you have fun playing Touhou Mystia’s Izakaya during the National day break!
-- I wanted to say some other things, but they stuck at my throat

notes.title: 预告：10月1日的完整版更新，同时本月无更新
notes.notes:
很多小伙伴正在等更新，为了让伙伴们知道我们在做什么，以及我们会解释为什么9月将没有更新。

我们原本的计划是9月内更新一个大版本供玩家游玩。但是由于我们原本就计划在10月1日更新完整版，现在整个团队正在开足马力追赶完整版的进度。如果9月再更新一个版本，势必会多花至少一周的时间在当前版本的稳定性上，导致10月国庆期间大家的游玩体验受到影响。因此我们将取消9月的大版本更新，以便我们有更多的时间和精力集中在眼前的进度上。

所以9月将没有大版本更新，但是国庆节期间、小伙伴们可以有时间又有心情一口气完成这个游戏。就当做大满足之前小小的忍耐吧。非常抱歉，同时也向等待的各位表示感谢。

另外，经过国庆周之后，完整版的游戏价格将向上调整，望周知。

一些玩家问调整后是否需要补差价的问题，在这里特别说明一下：
[u]首先从结论说起，在提价前已经购买的玩家，不需要补差价的。[/u]
已经购入的玩家，无论我们这边怎么折腾价格，都不影响您已经买到的东西，就好比您3块钱买了瓶可乐，后来如果我们把可乐定价为5块，您是不需要对调整价格后的可乐价格再负责的

接下来是10月1日完整版的更新预告、同时也是现在正在做的内容：
[list]
[*]实装新的剧情地图[olist]
[*]实装红魔馆剧情和地图
[*]实装永远亭(迷途竹林)剧情和地图
[*]实装白玉楼剧情和地图[/olist]
[*]实装BOSS战系统
[*]实装帮助做菜、传菜、传酒的店内[strike]资本家[/strike]伙伴系统[olist]
[*]幽谷响子在初始游戏时即可入队干活
[*]随着剧情推进，还有4位伙伴可以成为伙伴，她们会是谁呢？[/olist]
[*]实装地下室，这是玩家的收集要素展示区[olist]
[*]留声机，播放玩家已经激活的音乐
[*]相册，展示玩家已经收集到的剧情CG
[*]衣柜，更换玩家的移动行走图外观[/olist]
[*]原本的回收器回归成垃圾箱，酒柜和保温柜可以直接将拿错的东西放回去
[*]大量的全新剧情CG
[*]新增大量音乐，不过需要说明的是，我们是8月份临时做出了新增音乐的决定，原本是三首曲子贯穿全部游戏的夜间经营的，但是在广大玩家的喜爱之下，我们临时决定每个地区都分别使用本地区的气氛区，因此…在10月1的完整版音乐是实装不完了(尽管如此我们依然肝出了9首新曲)…但是10月内可以做完，请大家耐心等待。新曲包括：[olist]
[*]人间之里新增3首经营气氛曲
[*]博丽神社新增3首经营气氛曲
[*]白玉楼新增三首BOSS战气氛曲[/olist]
[*]实装香霖堂系统，其功能包括[olist]

[*]兑换限定纪念品，这里先不剧透，请大家期待[/olist]
[*]实装酒水兑换系统，通过循环任务，采集十六夜需求的食材(帮忙跑腿)，就给你对应的高级酒，是非常稳定的高级酒入手渠道
[*]开放每个地区的2、3级店面任务
[*]开放更多老板娘等级
[*]全新的新手引导教程
[*]清兰铃瑚的店内会开始卖小孩子的饮料，小孩子们终于可以不用再喝绿茶了
[*]取消EA赠送的酒水、食材

[*]客人的喜好标签正式采取渐进式，不再一开始就展示给玩家，而是玩家逐渐探索，每解锁一个喜好标签，就会记录在笔记本里面，让老板娘的笔记本越来越丰富，最终变成幻想乡的经营圣经
[*]实装店内装潢系统
[*]实装游戏结局
[*]实装成就
[/list]

notes.title: 各位好，久等了 我们做了20来天的羁绊系统今天初步迎来了实装
notes.notes:
各位好，久等了

我们做了20来天的羁绊系统今天初步迎来了实装。

所谓的羁绊系统，就是和幻想乡那些有名有姓的人物，进行交流、交际、促进关系，发生各种各样有趣互动的系统。你可以在白天的时候拜访她们，闲聊，提升好感度，待关系变好以后，就可以要求她们一些“过分”的事情，比如：
[list]
[*] 邀请来店，有成功概率，一旦成功邀请，今晚无论你店开在哪里，她今晚跋山涉水也一定会出现在店里
[*] 赠送礼物，可以提升好感度，不过这个系统还需要调试，暂时没有开放
[*] 请求食材，一定概率可以获得一些该对象喜好标签当中的食材，好感度越高，越容易得到更高等级的食材哦
[*] 请求酒水，同上
[*] 委托采集，可以委托该对象将本地图的素材进行一次采集，但不一定能采集到所有的素材，需要运气哦
[*] 获得限定的外观、店内装饰，以及…不过，这个还没有实装，还需要调试一段时间
[/list]
羁绊对象对你的好感度以桃心来显示等级，等级越高自然越好，上面的功能菜单也随着等级越高而解锁开放

那么怎样最快速的提升她们的好感度呢？——那当然是在她们光顾的时候做出她们喜欢的菜，让她们满意开心提升的最快啦！

现在开放的是兽道三人组的羁绊，即露米娅、橙以及莉格露，未来人里的羁绊进行调试后，会逐一开放

总之，希望大家玩的开心

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275129/4361b8e6274e767b8507a4d85279628ebfce0a4b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275129/c629da518ff7c75081c3abaac9ee1403dc376670.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40275129/486b2a3319b9f1d3780b68dd1f5b1a60b200f776.png[/img]

接下来是除了实装羁绊系统以外的其他更新：
[list]
[*] 为游戏制作了专属的鼠标指针 
[*] 白天的商人、任务、以及事件NPC现在会在头顶有对应的UI图标 
[*] 夜间的客人会在头顶显示当前的状态图标 
[*] 优化了部分UI的展示 
[*] 优化了红魔馆地图的部分美术表现效果 
[*] 修复了当白天NPC不在地图内时仍然会显示功能性图标的问题 
[*] 修复了部分文字显示为方框的问题 
[*] 修复了旧版存档读档之后兽道商人消失的问题
[*] 修复了无法进入新手教程、人里推车的问题
[/list]

notes.title: 首周10000份达成！…以及接下来十天左右的更新计划
notes.notes:
已经支持或正在观望《东方夜雀食堂》伙伴们大家好。

非常感谢，东方夜雀食堂在首周已经拥有了突破12000份的好成绩，为了感谢大家的支持，我们在游戏中准备了一份感谢小礼品，大家都收到了吗？虽然不能有什么实际的作用，但是是我们的一份心意。

这份礼品也会在6月30日23点59分59秒之后停止发放，请大家记得至少打开游戏领一次哦。
同时，在6月30日结束前购买游戏的玩家，也一样可以领取，不受影响。

关于更新计划，首先首发的这周，我们用了一周来修复BUG，目前的版本应该总算是相对稳定了。所以我们将从明天开始，正式开始新功能开发。

(虽然预期了10天左右，但目前实际开发时间已经超了，抱歉，还请大家再等等)

[h2]1、老板娘等级系统[/h2]

现在老板娘在店里跑断腿营业，只能获得钱对吧？其实还会获得经验值才对。不断营业的过程中，老板娘的熟练度会因此上升，然后升级！在升级之后，可以做的事情就更多了…其中大概包括
[list]
[*] 增加在店内的移动速度
[*] 减少制作料理的时间
[*] 延长buff的时间长度
[*] 增加招牌菜的数量
[*] 增加主打酒的数量
[*] 白天采集素材数量上升
[*] 等等…
[/list]
请大家期待等级系统的实装吧！

[h2]2、羁绊系统 兽道[/h2]

目前那些幻想乡的小伙伴，只能晚上来吃饭，但是没有任何的交互，一定让大家心痒难耐吧？
我们即将开始正式制作羁绊系统，一旦和伙伴们建立简单的交流关系之后，就可以通过不断的往来、交流、在店里进行营业满足她们，提升她们的好感度，接下来就可以跟她们一起触发越来越多的故事，同时还有很多便利功能！其中大概包括
[list]
[*] 邀请，成功的话，今晚必然出现在店里捧场
[*] 问她要一些她平时不用的食材或道具
[*] 委托她进行某个地区的食材采集，也有可能得到名贵的酒哦！
[*] 等等…
[/list]

总之，是两个值得期待的大功能，也可以填补大家做完兽道的章节后，百无聊赖的空白时间。

请再给我们一些时间，我们会做的更好的~！

感谢您看到这里。

——二色幽紫蝶游戏组
